courses.title: Modern Full-Stack React & Node.js Masterclass
courses.subtitle: Build production-ready, scalable web applications from scratch using MERN architecture
courses.description: An exhaustive, project-oriented masterclass covering modern React, Express.js REST APIs, MongoDB schema design, JWT authentication, state management, and cloud deployment. Learn through real-world architectural design patterns and industry best practices.
whatYouWillLearn: Master React 18+ component architecture, hooks, and context
Design RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express
Implement secure JWT authentication and password hashing with bcrypt
Build complex MongoDB databases with Mongoose schemas and relationships
Deploy full-stack applications with production security and performance
prerequisites: Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)
A computer with internet access and VS Code installed

lessons.title: Introduction to Full-Stack Architecture & Modern Web Ecosystem
lessons.description: Understand client-server architecture, HTTP protocols, REST conventions, and how React and Node work in unison.

lessons.title: React 18 Core Foundations: Components, State, & Effects
lessons.description: Deep dive into component lifecycle, useState, useEffect, customized hooks, and state immutability patterns.

lessons.title: Building RESTful APIs with Node.js & Express.js
lessons.description: Route controllers, middleware pipelines, error handling, and request validation in Express.

lessons.title: MongoDB & Mongoose Schema Architecture
lessons.description: Document-based database modeling, indexes, relationships, validations, and aggregation pipelines.

lessons.title: JWT Authentication & Role-Based Authorization
lessons.description: Securing API endpoints with JSON Web Tokens, bcrypt password hashing, and role verification middleware.

quiz.title: Full-Stack Web Development Comprehensive Assessment
quiz.description: Test your mastery of React, Express, MongoDB, and secure JWT authentication.

questions.questionText: What is the primary role of JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in full-stack architecture?
options: Stateless, digitally signed authentication and authorization between client and server
questions.explanation: JWTs provide a compact and self-contained way for securely transmitting information between parties as a JSON object, enabling stateless authorization.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP status code should be returned when a client attempts to access a protected route without a valid token?
questions.explanation: 401 Unauthorized is the standard HTTP status code indicating that authentication is required and has failed or has not been provided.

questions.questionText: In React, what hook should you use to handle side effects such as data fetching or subscriptions?
questions.explanation: useEffect allows you to perform side effects in functional components like API calls, event listeners, and DOM updates.

questions.questionText: In MongoDB, what is a document within a collection equivalent to in relational SQL databases?
questions.explanation: A MongoDB document is analogous to a single row or tuple in a relational SQL table.

courses.title: Deep Learning & Applied Machine Learning with Python
courses.subtitle: Comprehensive machine learning from linear models to deep neural networks
courses.description: Explore the foundations of predictive modeling, supervised and unsupervised learning, convolutional neural networks, and natural language processing using Python, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and NumPy.
whatYouWillLearn: Data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, and feature engineering
Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, and Random Forests
Neural network architectures, forward & backpropagation
Model evaluation metrics: Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC
Deploying ML models with REST APIs
prerequisites: Familiarity with Python syntax and basic linear algebra concepts

lessons.title: Python for Data Science: NumPy & Pandas Intensive
lessons.description: High-performance vector operations, DataFrame manipulations, and missing data imputation.

lessons.title: Supervised Learning Fundamentals & Cross Validation
lessons.description: Train-test splits, bias-variance tradeoff, k-fold cross validation, and regularization techniques.

lessons.title: Deep Neural Networks: Backpropagation & Optimization
lessons.description: Gradient descent variants (Adam, RMSProp), activation functions, and layer stacking.

quiz.title: Machine Learning Foundations Knowledge Check
quiz.description: Assess your understanding of supervised learning, model evaluation, and neural networks.

questions.questionText: What occurs when a machine learning model fits training data too closely and fails on unseen test data?
questions.explanation: Overfitting happens when a model memorizes noise and specific details in training data, compromising generalization to new datasets.

questions.questionText: Which metric is most useful for evaluating an imbalanced classification problem?
questions.explanation: F1-Score (harmonic mean of precision and recall) provides a balanced view when classes are severely skewed.

questions.questionText: What is the primary function of an activation function in a neural network layer?
options: To store the weights in GPU memory
To introduce non-linearity so the network can learn complex patterns
To normalize file sizes during training
To calculate the final database index
questions.explanation: Without non-linear activation functions (like ReLU or GELU), stacking linear layers would simply reduce to a single linear equation.

courses.title: Modern UI/UX Design System & Figma Prototyping
courses.subtitle: Create industry-grade design systems, wireframes, and interactive micro-prototypes
courses.description: Master visual hierarchy, accessibility standards (WCAG AAA), component variants, autolayout, design tokens, and user research methodologies using Figma.
whatYouWillLearn: Design tokens: Typography scales, color palettes, and 8pt spacing grid
Master Figma Auto-Layout 5.0 and nested component variants
Heuristic evaluations and usability testing protocols
Responsive design across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints
prerequisites: No prior design experience required. Free Figma account.

lessons.title: Design Principles & Visual Hierarchy 101
lessons.description: Contrast, alignment, proximity, repetition, and cognitive load management.

lessons.title: Figma Auto-Layout & Scalable Components
lessons.description: Building dynamic buttons, cards, and navigation bars with auto-layout and interactive states.

quiz.title: UI/UX Fundamentals & Design Systems Exam
quiz.description: Test your grasp of color contrast, typography rules, and component architecture.

questions.questionText: According to the 8-point spatial grid system, what is the recommended spacing unit multiplier?
questions.explanation: The 8-point grid scales predictably across display densities (1x, 2x, 3x) and ensures visual rhythm.

questions.questionText: What does WCAG 2.1 AA require as the minimum contrast ratio for normal body text against its background?
questions.explanation: WCAG AA requires at least 4.5:1 contrast for normal body copy to ensure legibility for users with visual impairments.

courses.title: Complete Cloud Architecture & Kubernetes on AWS
courses.subtitle: Deploy, manage, and scale cloud-native microservices with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS
courses.description: Learn cloud infrastructure engineering, VPC networking, IAM security, containerization with Docker, and orchestrating resilient production clusters with Kubernetes (EKS).
whatYouWillLearn: AWS Core Services: EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, and CloudWatch
Docker containerization best practices and multi-stage builds
Kubernetes Pods, Services, Deployments, ConfigMaps, and Ingress
CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and blue-green deployments
prerequisites: Basic Linux terminal experience and networking fundamentals

lessons.title: Cloud Computing Concepts & AWS Global Infrastructure
lessons.description: Regions, Availability Zones, Edge Locations, and Shared Responsibility Model.

lessons.title: Docker Containers from Development to Production
lessons.description: Writing clean Dockerfiles, image caching, container networking, and volumes.

quiz.title: Cloud & DevOps Architecture Certification Quiz
quiz.description: Verify your understanding of containerization, cloud networking, and orchestration.

questions.questionText: In Kubernetes, what is the smallest deployable computing unit?
questions.explanation: A Pod encapsulates one or more co-located containers, storage resources, and unique network IP.

questions.questionText: What AWS service provides managed relational databases with automated backups and failover?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS manages relational engines including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB.

courses.title: Ethical Hacking & Modern Cyber Security Defense
courses.subtitle: Hands-on penetration testing, network defense, vulnerability scanning, and cryptography
courses.description: Understand offensive security and practical defense mechanisms. Learn OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, reconnaissance, packet analysis with Wireshark, buffer overflows, and defensive hardening.
whatYouWillLearn: OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF)
Network penetration testing and Wireshark packet inspection
Asymmetric and symmetric encryption, TLS/SSL certificates
Zero Trust architecture and security posture auditing

lessons.title: Cyber Security Landscape & Threat Modeling
lessons.description: Attack vectors, CIA triad, threat modeling frameworks (STRIDE), and ethical rules of engagement.

lessons.title: OWASP Top 10: SQL Injection & Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
lessons.description: Dissecting how injection flaws manifest and how parameterized queries prevent them.

quiz.title: Cyber Security Defense Assessment
quiz.description: Test your knowledge of common attack vectors and defense techniques.

questions.questionText: What does the CIA triad stand for in information security?
questions.explanation: Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability are the three foundational pillars of information security.

questions.questionText: What is the primary method to prevent SQL Injection in backend applications?
questions.explanation: Parameterized queries separate SQL code from untrusted user input, neutralizing injection attempts.

courses.title: Cross-Platform Mobile Apps with React Native
courses.subtitle: Ship native iOS and Android apps with a single modern TypeScript & React codebase
courses.description: Build high-performance, fluid mobile applications. Learn native device APIs, push notifications, offline data caching, camera integration, and App Store / Google Play release preparation.
whatYouWillLearn: Expo framework, React Native core components and StyleSheet API
React Navigation 6 (Stack, Tabs, Drawers)
Hardware sensors, geolocation, and camera APIs
State management with Zustand and offline persistence
prerequisites: Working knowledge of React and JavaScript fundamentals

lessons.title: React Native & Expo Ecosystem Setup
lessons.description: Setting up the simulator, Expo Go, component bridges, and native flexbox layouts.

lessons.title: Navigation Flows: Tabs, Stacks, and Modals
lessons.description: Implementing fluid screen transitions and passing type-safe route parameters.

quiz.title: React Native Mobile Development Check
quiz.description: Assess your understanding of native mobile compilation and navigation.

questions.questionText: What is the equivalent of the HTML <div> tag in React Native?
questions.explanation: In React Native, the fundamental UI container component is <View>.

questions.questionText: How does React Native render native UI widgets on iOS and Android?
options: By running an embedded webview browser on every screen
By bridging JavaScript calls to invoke platform-specific native views (e.g. UIView on iOS, android.view.View on Android)
By compiling JS directly into x86 machine code ahead of time
questions.explanation: React Native communicates across an asynchronous bridge / JSI with native platform components to produce truly native performance.
